lines.text: After Jesus drives out a mute demon and the man speaks, some say He does it by Beelzebul, prince of the demons.
Others test Jesus by demanding a sign from heaven, and He says every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste.
Jesus says their sons will be their servants, and if He drives out demons by the finger of God, the kingdom of God has come.
Jesus calls the generation wicked and says no sign will be given except the sign of Jonah, who was a sign to the Ninevites.
The Queen of the South came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of David, and One greater is here.
